SELECT t.TRADE_ID tradeId,/**交易编号**/ t.F_TRADE_ID outTradeId, /*外部成交编号*/ NVL(deal1.BOOKSET_ID,deal2.BOOKSET_ID) prodId,/**金融产品代码**/ bok.BOOKSET_NAME prodName,/**金融产品名称**/ zc.FINPROD_MARKET_ID assetId, /**资产代码**/ zc.FINPROD_ABBR assetName,/**资产简称**/ t.PS ps,/**交易方向**/ t.TRADE_DATE tradeDate,/**交易日**/ t.SETTLE_DATE effDate,/**交割日期**/ t.INV_AIM invAim,/**投资目的**/ t.PRIN_AMT capital,/**本金金额**/ t.CPRICE_AMT cpriceAmt,/**净价总额**/ t.INT_AMT intAmt,/**应收利息总额**/ t.UNIT_CPRICE cprice,/**净价**/ t.CCY ccy,/**币种**/ stl.SETTLE_AMT settleAmt,/**结算金额**/ nvl(t.MY_ACCT_NO,stl.MY_ACCT_NO) myAcctNo/**资金账户**/ FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.finprod_id = t.finprod_id LEFT JOIN STL_ORDERS stl ON stl.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID AND stl.BUSI_TYPE in( '09') AND STL.ORDER_TYPE NOT LIKE 'N%' LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal1 on deal1.BUSI_NO = t.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal2 ON stl.ORDER_ID = deal2.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bok on (bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal1.BOOKSET_ID) OR (bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal2.BOOKSET_ID) where t.BUSI_TYPE ='09' and t.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F17' and t.PS IN('T01','T02')
and t.TRADE_ID like concat(concat('%',#{tradeId}),'%')
and NVL(deal1.BOOKSET_ID,deal2.BOOKSET_ID) IN
#{finprodId}
and zc.FINPROD_MARKET_ID IN
#{assetId}
and t.TRADE_DATE >= to_date(#{tradeDateBegin},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and t.TRADE_DATE <= to_date(#{tradeDateEnd},'yyyy-mm-dd')
AND t.PS IN
#{ps}
order by t.TRADE_ID desc
select count(1) from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL where TRADE_ID = #{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select t.TRADE_ID tradeId,/**交易编号**/ t.F_TRADE_ID outTradeId, /*外部成交编号*/ NVL(deal1.BOOKSET_ID,deal2.BOOKSET_ID) prodId,/**金融产品代码**/ bok.BOOKSET_NAME prodName,/**金融产品名称**/ zc.FINPROD_ID assetId, /**资产代码**/ zc.FINPROD_ABBR assetName,/**资产简称**/ t.PS ps,/**交易方向**/ t.TRADE_DATE tradeDate,/**交易日**/ t.SETTLE_DATE effDate,/**交割日期**/ t.INV_AIM invAim,/**投资目的**/ t.PRIN_AMT capital,/**本金金额**/ t.CPRICE_AMT cpriceAmt,/**净价总额**/ t.INT_AMT intAmt,/**应收利息总额**/ t.UNIT_CPRICE*100 cprice,/**净价**/ t.CCY ccy,/**币种**/ (t.CPRICE_AMT+t.INT_AMT) settleAmt,/**结算金额**/ nvl(t.MY_ACCT_NO,stl.MY_ACCT_NO) myAcctNo/**资金账户**/ FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.finprod_id = t.finprod_id LEFT JOIN STL_ORDERS stl ON stl.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID AND stl.BUSI_TYPE in( '09') AND STL.ORDER_TYPE NOT LIKE 'N%' LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal1 on deal1.BUSI_NO = t.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal2 ON stl.ORDER_ID = deal2.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bok on (bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal1.BOOKSET_ID) OR (bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal2.BOOKSET_ID) where t.BUSI_TYPE ='09' and t.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F17' and t.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and rownum=1
